ranked_ux_opportunities.description: Users experience frequent login issues, including being unable to log in after uninstalling and reinstalling the app.
user_quotes: I've tried several times today, but I can't get in.
It's like you don't even know when you'd be able to login to your account.
ranked_ux_opportunities.recommendation: Implement a more robust and user-friendly login system, including multi-factor authentication and clear error messaging.

ranked_ux_opportunities.description: Users experience delays in cash-ins, with some transactions taking more than a day to reflect on their balance.
user_quotes: The screen showed that it was successful, but the money never reflected on my balance until more than a day later.
ranked_ux_opportunities.recommendation: Optimize cash-in processing times by improving backend infrastructure and implementing real-time updates for users.

ranked_ux_opportunities.description: Users experience difficulties in contacting customer service, with some hotlines not working and emails being rejected.
user_quotes: I tried calling your toll-free hotline, but no one answered.
My email messages get rejected when sent to your Maya support services.
ranked_ux_opportunities.recommendation: Implement a more efficient and effective customer service system, including 24/7 hotlines and clear communication channels.

ranked_ux_opportunities.description: Users are reporting unauthorized transactions and difficulty in getting refunds.
user_quotes: I had an unauthorized transaction of PHP 9,000 and it took them a month to resolve.
They kept saying my case is still ongoing, but I've been waiting for months.
ranked_ux_opportunities.recommendation: Implement more robust security measures to prevent unauthorized transactions, including real-time monitoring and alerts.

ranked_ux_opportunities.description: Users are concerned about the security of their accounts, citing instances where hackers were able to access and steal funds.
user_quotes: My phone was stolen and the hacker was able to access this app and took my savings and made loan in a snap of a finger.
ranked_ux_opportunities.recommendation: Implement more robust security measures, including multi-factor authentication and regular security audits.

ranked_ux_opportunities.description: Users are concerned about data privacy, including the sharing of their personal information with third-party vendors.
user_quotes: I'm worried that my personal info will be leaked if I use this app.
I don't know why they're asking for my bank account details when I just want to cash in.
ranked_ux_opportunities.recommendation: Implement more transparent data collection and usage practices, including clear communication with users.

ranked_ux_opportunities.description: Users are experiencing issues with cashing in, including delayed or failed transactions.
